FX.name: USDTHB ensemble fair value
FX.what: log USDTHB vs DXY, gold, US 2y, USDJPY; average of 1y/2y/3y no-peek rolling regressions; daily + weekly tabs with residual, variables, betas, significance
FX.result: Validation 2025+: price closes 20% of the gap in 10d (t 2.1), model 'chases' 17% (n.s.), half-life ~11d, residual kurtosis 3.1 (≈normal). Now: near fair value.
FX.caveat: DXY and USDJPY collinear -> individual betas swing between windows; read fair value, not single betas. Fix: orthogonalise or drop JPY.
FX.next: orthogonalise JPY vs DXY; feed daily fair value to the hub

FX.name: USDTHB lead/lag ('price follows model')
FX.what: Which factor moves lead USDTHB; no-peek fair values chosen on 2019–24, validated 2025+
FX.result: USDTHB (Asia-stamped) reacts a day late to NY moves: DXY over today+yesterday (0.44), gold yesterday (−0.39), US 2y and SOFR–THB swap spread yesterday (+0.3). Simple base model beat spread/CNH versions in validation (hit 70% on |gap|>1.5σ, but slow).
FX.caveat: Tradable only if you can deal before USDTHB catches up (check the BBG close time).
FX.next: out-of-sample test of the overnight catch-up trade

FX.name: USDTHB regime betas / Kalman
FX.what: Separate betas by USD trend, VIX, THB vol, MOVE, Fed cycle; Kalman time-varying betas; Markov 2-state
FX.result: All chase price out of sample (model closes 30–60% of the gap itself). Ensemble wins. Don't re-test.

US Rates.name: Auction concession (10y/30y)
US Rates.what: Yields cheapen into coupon auctions? 797 auctions 2010–2026, Bloomberg closes
US Rates.result: Since 2022: 10y/30y cheapen +2.4–2.9bp in the 5 days into the auction (t ~1.5–1.9, ~0.25σ of 5-day noise); post-auction richening gone. Use as a timing overlay, not a trade.

US Rates.result: Mostly noise. Candidate: CPI-day 10y/30y moves continue over 3 days since 2022 (t ~1.7–2.1, 57 events). Shadow call logged for US CPI 10 Nov.
US Rates.caveat: Cloud proof on FRED closes; not yet on Bloomberg intraday.
